About RAZTECH

A Lebanese company built around water, soil, and containment

RAZTECH specializes in geosynthetic solutions for environmental, infrastructure, and water-related projects. Through partnerships with experienced international manufacturers, we offer products that meet recognized quality standards and project specifications.

Why RAZTECH

  • Specialized solutions tailored to each project
  • High-quality materials from experienced international manufacturers
  • Technical support from material selection through implementation
  • Reliable, cost-effective solutions

How we work

We work closely with contractors, consultants, subcontractors, and project owners to understand each project’s requirements. When needed, we coordinate with our manufacturers’ technical teams to confirm the proposed materials meet the technical specifications.

Products and solutions

A comprehensive range of geosynthetic materials, piping systems, and specialized solutions for environmental, infrastructure, water, marine, agricultural, and civil engineering projects. Products with a catalog or datasheet link to the Catalogs and Datasheets section.

Featured from SOTRAFA

ALVATECH HDPE waterproofing geomembranes, smooth or structured, for landfills, ponds, reservoirs, and channels.

Smooth HDPE geomembrane · GRI GM-13 · CE marked

ALVATECH 5002

A high-density polyethylene waterproofing geomembrane, smooth on both sides, made by SOTRAFA in Spain with cast system technology. Available from 0.75 to 3.00 mm thick.

Thickness range
0.75 – 3.00 mm
Roll widths
5.8 m / 7.5 m
Yield strength (nominal)
12 – 48 kN/m
Puncture resistance
340 – 980 N
Stress crack resistance
≥ 500 h
Request datasheet
Structured HDPE geomembrane · GRI GM-13 · CE marked

ALVATECH FIX

A high-density polyethylene waterproofing geomembrane structured on one side (FIX 1F) or both sides (FIX 2F), made with cast system technology. Covered by European standards for reservoirs, channels, tunnels, landfills, and transport infrastructure.

Structure
One side (1F) or both (2F)
Thickness, CE version
1.5 / 2.0 / 2.5 mm
Thickness, GM-13 version
60 / 80 / 100 mil
Spike height
> 0.8 mm
Roll width
7.5 m
Request datasheet

Values are nominal, taken from the manufacturer's datasheets, and are for reference only. GM-13 and CE datasheets are available on request.

Featured from GEOMAS

New additions to our range for hydraulic works, canals, ponds, and soil reinforcement.

GCCM – Geosynthetic Cementitious Composite Mat

Crete-X Plus

A flexible, rapid-installation alternative to traditional cast-in-place concrete for canals and ponds. Polypropylene geotextile layers on both sides, a high-density cementitious mix in the middle, and an LDPE coating on the bottom.

Compressive strength (after hydration)
60 MPa
Tensile strength
25 kN/m
Total composite thickness
11 mm
Roll size
5.0 × 20 m
Request datasheet
High-strength woven PES geotextile

HighTex 200/50

Made from high-modulus, low-shrinkage polyester fibers for high tensile strength at very low elongation. Designed to strengthen low-bearing-capacity soils, and non-biodegradable in soil. The HighTex series reaches up to 1,600 kN/m.

Tensile strength (MD / CMD)
200 / 50 kN/m
Elongation at break
12 / 12 %
CBR puncture
10,000 N
Mass per unit area
420 g/m²
Roll size
3.20 × 500 m
Request datasheet
Geocomposite filtration mat

TechTex SandMax DCM 5

A high-strength geocomposite of woven and nonwoven geotextiles with quartz-sand ballast, for filtration and protection at hydraulic structures. The sand ballast limits displacement of the filter material.

Tensile strength (MD / CMD)
> 32 / 32 kN/m
CBR puncture
> 6,000 N
Characteristic opening size
80 micron
Thickness at 2 kPa
8 mm
Roll size
5.20 × 40 m
Request datasheet

Applications

Where our solutions are used

Designed for environmental, infrastructure, water management, marine, agricultural, and civil engineering applications.

Landfills & waste containment

Lining, protection, drainage, and containment for municipal and industrial landfills.

Dams & ponds

Lining, waterproofing, protection, and drainage for dams, ponds, and reservoirs.

Water & drainage

Liquid collection, subsurface drainage, and leachate management.

Roads & infrastructure

Separation, reinforcement, stabilization, drainage, and load support.

Retaining & slope stabilization

Geogrid, geocell, gabion, and erosion-control solutions for slopes and retaining structures.

Marine & coastal

Mooring, fendering, port accessories, and protection in demanding environments.

Agriculture

Greenhouse and tunnel covers, irrigation, water storage, mulching, and hydroponics.

Below-grade & foundation waterproofing

Protection for foundations and underground structures against water and moisture.

Pipeline & sewer rehabilitation (CIPP)

Trenchless rehabilitation of existing pipelines and sewer networks, with less excavation and restoration work.
